annotation.title_clean: Emotion Recognition in Human-Robot Interaction: Multimodal Fusion, Deep Learning, and Ethical Considerations
annotation.title_en: Emotion Recognition in Human-Robot Interaction: Multimodal Fusion, Deep Learning, and Ethical Considerations
annotation.venue: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Data Analysis and Machine Learning (DAML), SciTePress
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper reviewing emotion recognition in human-robot interaction (perception-based, EEG-based, multimodal fusion, CNN/Transformer models) and its ethical implications, including data privacy, user consent and bias, stressing the need for regulatory frameworks. Only the abstract page is available.
key_provisions_or_claims: Reviews perception-based, EEG-based and multimodal emotion recognition in HRI
Deep learning (CNNs, Transformers) improves real-time recognition accuracy
Examines empathy in social robotics and its ethical implications
Highlights data privacy, user consent and unbiased AI concerns
Emphasizes regulatory frameworks for safe, ethical emotion-aware robots
